BTC weekly VRP is thin-positive (+2.3pp ungated) but (a) the pre-registered vol-of-vol gate (enter low/decaying DVOL) is EMPIRICALLY BACKWARDS — net-R is positive only in ELEVATED DVOL and negative in calm DVOL on both BTC and ETH; (b) a single vol-spike week gives back >1yr of premium (BTC worst trade ~-17.5% notional vs ~+15.7%/yr ungated maker); (c) ETH is negative in every config; (d) the VRP decays (+7.4 -> +3.1 -> +0.5pp by year). Fails G0 cost-first + the tail test; not diversifying vs carry (both eat the same vol-spike tail).

NO TRADEABLE LEADING EDGE — coincident echo, not lead. Aggregate stablecoin supply and TVL growth are STRONGLY COINCIDENT with price: the echo IC (flow vs the trailing week's return) is large and highly significant (up to +0.74), while the FORWARD IC is near-zero in 7 of 8 cells. The lead-lag correlogram peaks at NEGATIVE lag (h=-4..-29: flow LAGS price) and collapses to ~0 at h=0 and h>0 — the signature of a coincident macro echo, not a leading flow signal. The sole exception is ETH/tvl-30d (forward IC +0.151, raw p=0.006, Bonferroni p=0.049, +14.6%/yr excess over buy-and-hold, Granger t=+2.95), BUT its echo IC (+0.37) is 2.4x its forward IC, so it FAILS the load-bearing lead-vs-echo test (the signal is far more a reflection of the past week's price than a prediction of the next) — a single marginal cell among 8, consistent with a slow-TVL-trend/trend-filter effect rather than an independent causal flow lead. On-chain/macro flow does NOT lead price at a tradeable weekly horizon. NOT promoted — matching the prior exactly.
